additional_info.subject: ID0467456-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/RD 170003001] Charging issue CRM:02889000931
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support, and apologies for the delay in replying to your request.
After carefully checking the timestamp of the charger, we found that in the time of the charging process, the network of the charger was unreachable.
This is why the charging session faulted.
The charger looks healthy now and the connection looks stable.
We will keep an eye on the charger for the next three days, to see if the connection fails again.
After these three days, we will close the ticket.
Please provide us with feedback, if the problem occurred again.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
